Open-source desktop project2026 – Present

Meetfolio

Stay in the conversation. Find the important parts later.

What it is
A local-first, open-source desktop workspace for interviews and meetings: prepare an outline, record and transcribe on your own computer, keep reference documents beside the transcript, then review and export.
Who it's for
Interviewers, researchers, students, consultants and product teams who need an accurate record without losing attention during the conversation.
Problems it solves
  • Listening, note-taking, documents and follow-up questions are spread across separate apps.
  • Afterwards it is hard to reconstruct exactly what was said — and which notes came from you, the transcript or an AI.
  • Many tools need an account and send recordings to the cloud; Meetfolio keeps the core workflow on the device.
My role
Product creator · workflow design · AI-assisted implementation (Electron, local sherpa-onnx speech recognition) · testing · documentation
Source code on GitHub ↗Next: AbTrace →

Status & limits Transcription quality depends on audio, language and hardware. Optional AI features need a configured provider. Long real-microphone sessions and signed public releases are still being validated; Meetfolio is not a certified recordkeeping system.
